verdict.rationale: Asana's AI Studio (no-code automations), AI Teammates, and Dash are marketed as capable of handling coordination/triage-like work and could plausibly automate task prioritization, but no evidence specifically shows AI auto-triaging or prioritizing incoming bugs/tasks in practice. Missing for 10: concrete documentation or hands-on example of AI-driven bug/task triage and prioritization rules, independent corroboration of this specific workflow working in production.
